categories.name: Lights & effects
categories.about: Lamps, particle effects, glows, outlines and animated textures.

categories.name: Sound
categories.about: Sound emitters, music and the acoustic rooms that shape echo and muffling.

categories.name: Environment & rendering
categories.about: Weather and fog zones, shading volumes, water, plants that bend, draw distance.

categories.name: Engine & system
categories.about: Behind-the-scenes objects: resources to preload, game systems, UI and debug helpers.

CRigidObject.name: Model / prop
CRigidObject.about: A placed 3D model: furniture, cars, crates, rubble, doors, fences ... Its 'filename' is the model, 'collision' its physics shape, 'type' whether it is static, can be pushed or breaks. The most common kind of object by far.

CStaticDecalObject.name: Decal (painted on)
CStaticDecalObject.about: A texture projected onto the ground or a wall: oil stains, road markings, dirt, scorch marks, posters. Has its own colour, glow and fade distance.

CDynamicDecalObject.name: Decal (on something)
CDynamicDecalObject.about: A decal stuck to an object or a body bone (blood, dirt) that can be switched on and off by events.

CSkeletalAnimatedObject.name: Animated model
CSkeletalAnimatedObject.about: A model with a skeleton that plays animations (e.g. a moving machine part or a dead body pose).

CDeployableDestructibleObject.name: Destructible deployable
CDeployableDestructibleObject.about: Something placed that can be taken, destroyed or explodes: mines, explosive barrels, deployable gear.

CCompiledRoadObject.name: Road decoration piece
CCompiledRoadObject.about: A piece generated along a road: how it sits on the terrain, its width and texture.

CPlaceBuilding.name: Base building slot
CPlaceBuilding.about: A place where the player can build a base structure.

CBuildingGridSpawned.name: Base building grid
CBuildingGridSpawned.about: The building grid of a player base.

CAttachableObject.name: Attachable part
CAttachableObject.about: A part that can be attached to another object.

COffsetObject.name: Offset helper
COffsetObject.about: Moves its children by an offset.

CPosRefObject.name: Position reference
CPosRefObject.about: A point other objects refer to for their position.

CMoveRigidObjectOverTime.name: Moving model
CMoveRigidObjectOverTime.about: Moves a model from one place to another over time.

CWaterBox.name: Water volume
CWaterBox.about: A box of water (pools, flooded rooms).

CLootCrateSpawnPoint.name: Loot spot
CLootCrateSpawnPoint.about: A spot where loot can appear. 'spawn_tags' says what kind (weapons, ammo, apparel_pack ...), 'chance' how likely, and 'distance_limit' how close you must be for it to spawn.

CLootCrateSpawnPointGroup.name: Loot spot group
CLootCrateSpawnPointGroup.about: Groups loot spots so only some of them spawn at once.

CPlacementRule.name: Item placement
CPlacementRule.about: Places an item or object by tag (fuel cans, consumables ...) with a chance, like a loot spot.

CEquipmentItem.name: Item
CEquipmentItem.about: An item lying in the world, or an item definition (weapons, clothes, augments, consumables).

CThrowableItem.name: Throwable item
CThrowableItem.about: A grenade, flare or other throwable lying in the world.

CDeployableItem.name: Deployable item
CDeployableItem.about: A deployable (trap, mine, decoy) lying in the world.

CLootModifier.name: Loot modifier
CLootModifier.about: Changes the loot of the containers in its area (quality, amount).

CCollectable.name: Collectible
CCollectable.about: A collectible pickup (notes, photos, gnomes, mixtapes, schematic points ...). 'save_type' controls whether picking it up is remembered in the save.

CLootSystem.name: Loot system
CLootSystem.about: The game's loot system (one in the world).

CAnimalGroupSpawnPoint.name: Machine spawn
CAnimalGroupSpawnPoint.about: A fixed machine group spawn (patrols, guards, rivals). Its spawn components say which machine type and class.

CDynamicMachineSpawnPoint.name: Machine spawn (dynamic)
CDynamicMachineSpawnPoint.about: A machine spawn used by events and missions.

CMachineInterest.name: Machine point of interest
CMachineInterest.about: A point machines walk to and investigate ('type': investigate_point, look_at ...).

CMachineInterestZone.name: Machine interest zone
CMachineInterestZone.about: An area machines like to patrol or gather in.

CMachineLureObject.name: Machine lure
CMachineLureObject.about: Attracts machines within its range when switched on (alarms, noises).

CPlayerSpawnPoint.name: Player spawn / safehouse
CPlayerSpawnPoint.about: Where the player can respawn: safehouses and bases.

CHordeMission.name: Horde / wave event
CHordeMission.about: A machine horde or wave event: which machines come in which waves.

CBaseAssaultObject.name: Base assault
CBaseAssaultObject.about: Sets up machine attacks on a player base.

CNotifySpawner.name: Spawn notifier
CNotifySpawner.about: Tells a spawner to spawn when triggered.

CVehicleRule.name: Vehicle rules
CVehicleRule.about: Rules for vehicles in an area.

CCharacterRule.name: Character rules
CCharacterRule.about: Rules for characters (machines/NPCs) in an area.

CPOI.name: Map marker / point of interest
CPOI.about: A point of interest: map icons, mission markers, tooltips. 'show_on_map' puts it on the map.

CControlPOI.name: Control point marker
CControlPOI.about: The map marker of a control point (a base you can take).

CLandmark.name: Landmark
CLandmark.about: A named landmark the game discovers when you come close.

CRegion.name: Region
CRegion.about: A map region or zone (regions, world borders, mission areas) with its border shape.

CBookMark.name: Editor bookmark / note
CBookMark.about: A note the developers left in the level ('note' holds the text key). Not seen in game.

CLocationSummary.name: Location summary
CLocationSummary.about: The summary of a map location: what it holds and how far you have looted it.

CLocationSummaryWeaponToken.name: Location summary: weapon
CLocationSummaryWeaponToken.about: Counts a weapon in the location's summary.

CLocationSummaryMissionToken.name: Location summary: mission
CLocationSummaryMissionToken.about: Counts a mission in the location's summary.

CLocationSummaryNestToken.name: Location summary: nest
CLocationSummaryNestToken.about: Counts a nest in the location's summary.

CLocationSummarySpawnedInteractToken.name: Location summary: loot
CLocationSummarySpawnedInteractToken.about: Counts a loot container in the location's summary.

CMissionQuery.name: Mission check
CMissionQuery.about: Watches a mission or objective and sends events when it starts, completes or becomes inactive.

CPostMissionEventObject.name: After-mission event
CPostMissionEventObject.about: Sends an event after a mission.

CBountyCompleteTrigger.name: Bounty complete
CBountyCompleteTrigger.about: Fires when a bounty is completed.

CNamedPoint.name: Named point
CNamedPoint.about: A named position that missions refer to.

CDialogue.name: Dialogue line
CDialogue.about: A voice line / subtitle played on an event.

CConversation.name: Conversation
CConversation.about: A conversation made of dialogue lines.

CUIMessage.name: On-screen message
CUIMessage.about: Shows a message or prompt on the HUD when triggered.

CUIHealthBar.name: Health bar
CUIHealthBar.about: Shows a health bar on the HUD.

CIncreaseStatTrigger.name: Stat counter
CIncreaseStatTrigger.about: Increases a player statistic (for challenges and achievements).

CGoTrackMessageEvent.name: Tracking event
CGoTrackMessageEvent.about: Sends a game tracking / statistics event.

CEventTrigger.name: Event trigger
CEventTrigger.about: A switch that passes events on (enable / disable / next / random).

CLookAtTrigger.name: Look-at trigger
CLookAtTrigger.about: Fires when the player looks at something within 'range' (e.g. to show a prompt).

CDistanceTrigger.name: Distance trigger
CDistanceTrigger.about: Fires when the player (on foot, in a car, on a bike, in a boat) comes within 'trigger_distance'.

CShapeTrigger.name: Area trigger
CShapeTrigger.about: Fires when the player, a vehicle, a weapon or an explosion enters or leaves its shape.

CTimeTrigger.name: Timer
CTimeTrigger.about: Waits 'time' seconds after it starts, then fires (optionally looping or showing a bar).

CPersistentTimer.name: Saved timer (respawn)
CPersistentTimer.about: A timer kept in the save, e.g. loot respawn time ('time' in seconds, 14400 = 4 hours).

CCountTrigger.name: Counter
CCountTrigger.about: Counts events and fires when it reaches a number.

CCreationTrigger.name: On-creation trigger
CCreationTrigger.about: Fires when the location is created / loaded.

CEventRouter.name: Event switch
CEventRouter.about: Routes events one way or the other depending on its state.

CGraphObject.name: Scripted object (graph)
CGraphObject.about: Runs a logic graph ('script') - doors, switches, lockers, hack consoles, light flicker ...

CNetworkBoolState.name: On/off state (synced)
CNetworkBoolState.about: An on/off state shared in co-op and kept in the save (a door open, a light on).

CRemoteTrigger.name: Remote trigger
CRemoteTrigger.about: Sends a signal to remote receivers with the same 'filter' (e.g. satellite dishes).

CRemoteTriggerReceiver.name: Remote receiver
CRemoteTriggerReceiver.about: Receives remote trigger signals with its 'filter'.

CSendObjectDestroyed.name: Destroyed notifier
CSendObjectDestroyed.about: Tells the game a named object was destroyed.

CDoActOnEventObject.name: Act on event
CDoActOnEventObject.about: Does an action when an event comes in.

CEnableParentObject.name: Enable parent
CEnableParentObject.about: Enables or disables the object it is in.

CBuildingEventsInterface.name: Building events
CBuildingEventsInterface.about: Events of a player base building.

CAnimRotation.name: Rotating part
CAnimRotation.about: Turns its children around an axis on events: doors, hatches, gates, fans.

CAnimTranslation.name: Sliding part
CAnimTranslation.about: Slides its children along a direction on events: drawers, lifts, sliding doors.

CAnimSpline.name: Path animation
CAnimSpline.about: Moves its children along a curve.

CConstraint.name: Physics joint
CConstraint.about: Joins two physics objects (hinges, ball joints, wheels).

CForcePulse.name: Explosion
CForcePulse.about: An explosion: radius, force and the effect it plays.

CForcePoint.name: Force
CForcePoint.about: Pushes physics objects with a force while on.

CDamageController.name: Damage / health
CDamageController.about: Gives its object health and a faction, and sends events when it is hit or destroyed.

CAreaDamage.name: Damage area
CAreaDamage.about: Hurts what is inside its radius every 'interval' seconds (fire, gas, saw blades).

CDamageableCharacterPart.name: Damageable part
CDamageableCharacterPart.about: A part of a character that can take damage.

CMotionAttachmentVolume.name: Motion attach volume
CMotionAttachmentVolume.about: Things inside it move along with it.

CDynamicLightObject.name: Light
CDynamicLightObject.about: A lamp: colour ('diffuse'), radius, spot angles, shadows, flare and flicker ranges.

CDynamicLightFlasher.name: Flashing light
CDynamicLightFlasher.about: A light that flashes on and off.

CEffectPointEmitter.name: Effect (point)
CEffectPointEmitter.about: Plays a particle effect and/or sound at a point: smoke, sparks, fire, dust, insects ...

CEffectPlaneEmitter.name: Effect (area)
CEffectPlaneEmitter.about: Plays an effect over a flat area.

CEffectLineEmitter.name: Effect (line)
CEffectLineEmitter.about: Plays an effect along a line.

COutline.name: Outline (highlight)
COutline.about: The coloured outline drawn around an object (e.g. lootables).

CSpeaker.name: Sound emitter
CSpeaker.about: Plays a sound from its spot (hums, radios, machinery).

CSoundModuleFMODEvent.name: Sound event
CSoundModuleFMODEvent.about: Plays a sound event from the game's sound banks.

CSoundModuleSendFunction.name: Sound function
CSoundModuleSendFunction.about: Sends a command to the sound system.

CSoundAcousticBox.name: Acoustic room
CSoundAcousticBox.about: A room that changes how sound echoes and is muffled inside it ('room_name').

CSoundAcousticCompound.name: Acoustic room (compound)
CSoundAcousticCompound.about: A room made of several acoustic boxes.

CSoundLayerEmitter.name: Sound layer
CSoundLayerEmitter.about: Plays a layer of ambient sound.

CSoundBeatTrigger.name: Sound beat trigger
CSoundBeatTrigger.about: Fires on the beat of a sound.

CSoundGroupRandom.name: Random sound group
CSoundGroupRandom.about: Plays a random sound from a group.

CSoundResourcePreloader.name: Sound preloader
CSoundResourcePreloader.about: Loads sound banks ahead of time.

CListenerEffects.name: Listener effects
CListenerEffects.about: Effects on what the player hears.

CAOVolumeObject.name: Shading volume
CAOVolumeObject.about: Darkens the space inside it (ambient occlusion) so interiors and under-roof areas look shaded; also blocks rain ('RainOccluder').

CEnvironmentPresets.name: Weather / fog zone
CEnvironmentPresets.about: Changes fog, sky and lighting in an area using an environment file ('file').

CVegInteractionObject.name: Plant bender
CVegInteractionObject.about: Pushes grass and bushes aside around it (under cars, crates).

CDisableAtDistance.name: Distance switch-off
CDisableAtDistance.about: Switches the objects in it off when the player is far away, to save performance.

CVisibilityGroup.name: Visibility group
CVisibilityGroup.about: Shows or hides a group of objects together.

CAIVisionBlocker.name: Vision blocker
CAIVisionBlocker.about: Blocks machines' sight through it (bushes, smoke, fences).

CDynamicNavMeshCutter.name: Navigation blocker
CDynamicNavMeshCutter.about: Cuts machines' walkable area where it stands.

CAiRestrictedZone.name: No-go zone for AI
CAiRestrictedZone.about: Machines may not enter this area.

CTeleportBlocker.name: Fast-travel blocker
CTeleportBlocker.about: Blocks teleporting / fast travel into this spot.

CBreadcrumbWaypointGroup.name: Waypoint path
CBreadcrumbWaypointGroup.about: A path of waypoints for characters to follow.

CResourceObject.name: Resource to load
CResourceObject.about: Makes the game load a file (a texture, model ...) with the location.

CDebugTextObject.name: Debug text
CDebugTextObject.about: Developer debug text, not shown in the game.

CSplineObject.name: Curve
CSplineObject.about: A curve used by other objects.

CShapeTriggerComponent.name: Trigger shape
CShapeTriggerComponent.about: The shape (box, sphere ...) of an area trigger.

CLookAtTriggerPointComponent.name: Look-at point
CLookAtTriggerPointComponent.about: The point a look-at trigger checks, with its 'angle'.

CLookAtTriggerShapeComponent.name: Look-at shape
CLookAtTriggerShapeComponent.about: The shape a look-at trigger checks.

CEnvironmentZone.name: Weather / fog zone shape
CEnvironmentZone.about: One box or shape of a weather / fog zone, with its falloff.

CSoundModuleFMODEventFunction.name: Sound event function
CSoundModuleFMODEventFunction.about: Starts, stops or changes a sound event.

CSoundGroupRandomComponent.name: Random sound
CSoundGroupRandomComponent.about: One sound of a random sound group.

SSoundAcousticComponent.name: Acoustic room part
SSoundAcousticComponent.about: One part of an acoustic room.

SSoundAcousticPortal.name: Acoustic opening
SSoundAcousticPortal.about: A door or window opening that lets sound out of an acoustic room.

SAttachedEffect.name: Attached effect
SAttachedEffect.about: An effect attached to an object.

CMaterialEffectTable.name: Impact effects
CMaterialEffectTable.about: Which effect plays when something hits each material.

COutlineRef.name: Outline link
COutlineRef.about: Links an object to its outline.

SAnimationLayerInfo.name: Animation layer
SAnimationLayerInfo.about: An animation layer of an animated model.

STargetPoint.name: Aim point
STargetPoint.about: A point machines aim at on an object ('size_scale').

SMachineInterestTarget.name: Interest target
SMachineInterestTarget.about: A target a machine point of interest points at.

SMachineInterestZoneSetting.name: Interest zone setting
SMachineInterestZoneSetting.about: A setting of a machine interest zone.

CGameObjectDespawnObject.name: Despawner
CGameObjectDespawnObject.about: Removes its object on an event.

SAnimalGroupSpawnComponent.name: Spawned machine group
SAnimalGroupSpawnComponent.about: What a machine spawn spawns: machine type ('machine_type') and class, rival title and name, tags.

SDynamicMachineSpawnComponent.name: Spawned machine (dynamic)
SDynamicMachineSpawnComponent.about: What a dynamic machine spawn spawns.

SHordeSpawnedAnimal.name: Horde machine
SHordeSpawnedAnimal.about: A machine type and class in a horde.

CBaseAttackPlan.name: Base attack plan
CBaseAttackPlan.about: How machines attack a player base.

CConstraintLimitedHingeData.name: Limited hinge
CConstraintLimitedHingeData.about: A hinge that only swings so far.

CModelAttachementWeaponComponent.name: Weapon attachment
CModelAttachementWeaponComponent.about: A weapon attached to a model.

SWeaponPoint.name: Weapon point
SWeaponPoint.about: Where a weapon sits on an object.

SBulletSpawnerBarrel.name: Gun barrel
SBulletSpawnerBarrel.about: A barrel of a bullet spawner.

components.SEventTriggerComponent: An event name another object fires.
components.SDCRef: A link from a damage controller to the object it damages.
components.SPhysicsParams: Physics settings of an object: mass, drag, buoyancy, damping.
components.SEnvironmentPreset: One setting of a weather / fog zone.
components.SMachineInterestTarget: A target a machine interest points at.
components.SAnimalGroupSpawnComponent: What a machine spawn spawns: machine type and class, rival names, tags.
components.SItemCompatibility: Which items an item works with.
components.SHordeSpawnedAnimal: A machine in a horde wave.

props.name: The object's name in the level (not shown in game).
props._class_hash: The kind of object, as a hash.
props._object_id: The object's unique id. Saves remember looted / destroyed / collected objects by it; copies get new ones.
props.world: Position and rotation (relative to the object it is in).
props.name_hash: Hash of the name, used by events and scripts to find the object.
props.filename: The model (or file) it uses, as a path hash.
props.filename_variant: Which variant of the model (burnt, prototype ...).
props.collision: The physics shape, as a path hash.
props.enabled: Whether it starts switched on (1 = yes).
props.Enabled: Whether it starts switched on (1 = yes).
props.type: A setting that picks how it behaves; the numbers differ by kind.
props.send_to_reverb: Whether its sound goes through the room echo.
props.clip: Whether it is clipped by the camera near plane.
props.debug_me: A developer debug switch (always 0 in the shipped game).
props.size_cull: Hide it when it is small on screen (likely name).
props.color_tint_detail: Colour tint of the detail texture (likely name).
props.make_dynamic: Event that makes it a physics object.
props.faction: Which side it belongs to (machines, player, neutral ...).
props.health: How much damage it takes before it is destroyed.
props.on_destroy: Events sent when it is destroyed.
props.on_hit: Events sent when it is hit.
props.chance: How likely it is to spawn (0 to 1).
props.spawn_tags: What spawns here (tags of loot or items).
props.distance_limit: Spawns only when the player is within this many metres.
props.ground_snap: Snap to the ground when spawning.
props.orientation: How the spawned thing is turned.
props.unload_auto_despawn: Remove what it spawned when the area unloads.
props.weather: Only spawns in this weather (0 = any).
props.time_start: Only spawns after this hour (0 = any).
props.time_end: Only spawns before this hour (0 = any).
props.attach_object: The object it is attached to.
props.radius: Size of the area / light, in metres.
props.range: How far it reaches, in metres.
props.specular_multiplier: How shiny the light makes surfaces.
props.spot_inner_angle: Inner cone angle of a spot light.
props.spot_outer_angle: Outer cone angle of a spot light.
props.has_flare: Whether it shows a lens flare.
props.cull_distance: Not drawn further away than this (metres).
props.effect: The effect it plays, as a path hash.
props.play_on_enabled: Plays as soon as it is switched on.
props.play_count: How many times it plays (4294967295 = forever).
props.retrigger_time: Seconds before it can play again.
props.random_offset: Random shift each time it plays.
props.no_vehicle: Reacts only to the player on foot.
props.test_visibility: Only fires when the target is actually visible.
props.max_distance: Shown up to this distance (-1 = always).
props.save_type: How picking it up is saved.
props.collect_event: Events when it is picked up.
props.occlusion: How much the walls muffle sound.
props.translation: How far it slides (x, y, z).
props.at_end: Events sent when it reaches the end.
props.at_start: Events sent when it is back at the start.
props.label_key: Text key of the name shown in game.
props.content_key: Which game content (base game / DLC) it belongs to.
